trigger.name: trg_context_xep_hang
trigger.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_context_xep_hang AFTER INSERT ON public.chat_zalo_message FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((new.direction = 'incoming'::text) AND (COALESCE(new.content_text, ''::text) <> ''::text))) EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_context_trg_chat_zalo_message()

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_context_trg_chat_zalo_message()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  begin
    perform public.fn_context_xep_hang('chat_zalo_message', new.id::text);
  exception when others then
    raise warning 'fn_context_trg_chat_zalo_message %: % (%)', new.id, sqlerrm, sqlstate;
  end;
  return null;
end $function$
